Only successful domain departures can prune rows; actual post-write trash membership is intersected and a current one-domain trash view is exempt. Multiple-local-domain survivors, already-trash selections and locked physical no-ops retain rows/selection. Actual physical deletion still prunes wholly current local views independently. Source-page callbacks cannot target a successor and retained rows invalidate stale inbox/trash icons.
